newsitem.title: POLAND: Slaski starts first Polish on-line card.
newsitem.headline: Slaski starts first Polish on-line card.

text.p: Bank Slaski SA started issuing Visa Electron cards, the first on-line debit card on the Polish market, Slaski's deputy president said on Tuesday.
Andrzej Walkiewicz told a news conference the bank, which was launching the card after a $150,000 marketing campaign expected to issue 100,000 cards by the end of this year.
"The issue of the Visa Electron card, with the help of Visa association, will help us significantly improve the quality of our service," Walkiewicz said.
Slaski said in a statement that the new card would be made available to all holders of its 160,000 accounts.

Alan Goslar, deputy president of Visa International, also present, said Visa expected nine further banks would soon start issuing Visa Electron and they were expected to issue a total of 600,000 cards by mid-1998.
